main_text.p: ipsum ignem perpetuò duraturum putent. Ita docu-it (ut vidimus) Jahm, quem Jahmianorum secta au-thorem habuit : scil. finem habituros Paradisum & ignem postquam eos ingressi fuerint qui iis destina-ti, verba autem illa Alcorani خالدين فيها i. e. AlMoraiez. & Sharest. Perpetuò in iis mansuri, intelligenda esse على المبالغة والتاكيد دون الحقيقة في التخليد كما يقال خلد الله ملكه ذلان ad modum Hyperboles & majoris confirmationis, non quod revera significent illos in iis, (i. e. Paradiso & inferno) in aeternum manfuros, ficut dicitur, in faeculum durare faciat Deus, regnum τὰ δεῦρο[?]. Ab hoc rursum diversus Alfabedh[?] (cujus & antea meminimus) quod ad eos qui igni a Judicantur statuit الذين[?] لا يخلدون فيها عذابا بل يصيرون الي طبيعة النار Non perpetuò eos in illo cruciandos, sed in ejus naturam converfos iri, insuper asferens, ignem ad fe attrahere illi desti-natos, nec quempiam in illum immittì. Hi tamen omnes & Paradisum & Infernum in altero faeculo statuunt, at secus AlGhattabiani ex AlShiis (qui Abul-Chattabi cujusdam asseclæ) quibus est referente Eb-nolKaffai الجنة نعيم الدنيا والنار الامها Paradisus delitiæ hujus mundi, & ignis dolor ejus. Affirmarunt (inquit AlShirestanius.) ان الدنيا لا يغني وان الجنة هي التي تصيب الناس من خير ونعمة وعافية وان النار هي التي تصيب الناس من شر

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek "τὰ δεῦρο" is hard to read at the line end; the Arabic word before "لا يخلدون فيها" and the Latin "Alfabedh" are uncertain; "asferens" may be "adferens" or "superaferens" in the print; the Arabic line ending "من شر" continues the text. The marginal note was placed where it stands beside the upper lines. Scan marks at the left margin and the digitiser's line at bottom right are not printed text and are omitted.
